rationale: A unanimous, precedent-anchored textual holding centered on Strang and the phrase “obtained by” makes the Chief Justice the most likely assignee/author, with Gorsuch and Kagan as plausible alternatives for a clean, administrable rule keyed to state-law imputation. The main risk of separate writing is a concurrence (especially from Jackson or Gorsuch) emphasizing fairness/procedural safeguards and tight limits on when state-law agency/partnership principles properly impute fraud for § 523(a)(2)(A) purposes.
